info.title: Socrates API
info.summary: Public surface of the Socrates tutor: health, bootstrap, auth, mobile bearer exchange, OAuth 2.0, async jobs, and bulk operations.
info.description: Socrates (topodrive.top) is an AI tutor. This document covers the public API surface — health, bootstrap, OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow, scoped agent API keys, async import jobs, and a bulk-create endpoint. Authenticated browser routes (`/api/sessions`, `/api/chat`, `/api/files`) follow the same conventions and reuse the schemas declared here. Long-form reference: https://topodrive.top/llms-full.txt. Agent instructions: https://topodrive.top/agents.md.
info.x-deprecation-policy: Versioned under `/api/v2/*`. Deprecations signal via the `Deprecation` and `Sunset` response headers (RFC 8594) at least 90 days before removal. See https://topodrive.top/announcements for the announcement feed.

get.description: Returns 200 when the API and primary database are reachable, with pubsub transport status. Returns 503 when the database is unreachable.
Simple GET returning a static greeting. Useful as the cheapest possible smoke-test.

Returns a small capability blob for the SPA: whether the built-in provider is configured and whether it is reasoning-capable. The SPA uses this to choose stream timeouts and reasoning effort; the underlying model identity is intentionally not exposed.
Issues a CSRF token and sets the matching double-submit cookie. Required as a preflight for state-changing browser routes.

post.description: Authenticate a browser user via email and password. Issues a `sid` session cookie on success.

200.description: Login successful. Set-Cookie: sid=<64-hex>; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax.

post.description: Create a new Socrates account and trigger an email-verification flow.

get.description: Redirects the browser to GitHub's authorization endpoint with an HMAC-signed state parameter. On callback the session is exchanged for a `sid` cookie.
GitHub redirects back here with `code` and `state`. The server exchanges the code, finds-or-creates the user, and either sets the `sid` cookie or returns a short-lived mobile-exchange token.

302.description: Redirected back to the originating return path with `sid` cookie set.

get.description: Public, secret-free contract used by the Android shell before it opens the shared SPA. Caches with `Cache-Control: no-store` so every cold start re-validates the contract.

post.description: Issues a 15-minute `ma.<pairId>.<hex>` access token paired with a long-lived `mr.*` refresh token. Used by the Android shell.

get.description: Public health probe reachable at the same-origin mobile contract prefix `/api/v2/health`. Nginx rewrites the path to `/api/health`. Useful for the Android shell bootstrap and the deploy-script gate.
Returns the user record attached to the ambient `sid` cookie. Useful for boot-time session validation in the SPA and for agents that already have a `sid` they want to verify.

post.description: Server-side revocation of the `sid` cookie. Idempotent — calling on a non-existent session returns 200 with `{ ok: true }`.

get.description: Anonymous, secret-free status feed consumed by status.topodrive.top. No auth, no rate limit beyond what nginx imposes; safe to poll.

post.description: Exchanges a long-lived `mr.*` refresh token for a fresh `ma.*` access token. The refresh token is rotated on every successful exchange.

Open dynamic client registration for third-party agents. No human in the loop — POST a JSON document with at least `client_name` and `redirect_uris[]` and receive a `client_id` + `client_secret` (shown once). PKCE (`S256`) is required by default. Rate-limited per IP.

201.description: Client registered. Secret returned ONCE — store immediately.

post.description: Exchanges an authorization `code` (with PKCE verifier) for an access+refresh token pair, or refreshes an existing refresh token. Authenticated via HTTP Basic with the registered client credentials.
Revoke an access or refresh token. Killing either half of a pair invalidates both. Authenticated via HTTP Basic with the registered client credentials.

200.description: Revocation accepted (idempotent — a no-op on an unknown token still returns 200).

get.description: List the scoped agent API keys minted by the authenticated user. Never returns the secret material — only `keyId`, `label`, `scopes`, and timestamps.

post.summary: Mint a scoped agent API key
post.description: Create a long-lived scoped API key for a headless agent. The full credential is returned exactly once in the create response; subsequent reads never expose the secret.

delete.description: Immediate, idempotent revocation. The key stops authenticating on the next request.

get.description: Returns the 20 most recent import jobs for the authenticated user, regardless of status.

post.description: Submit a bulk import of sessions, messages, or other resources. Returns a job identifier; poll `GET /api/import/{id}` for status. Use the `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe — the same key returns the same job.

get.description: Returns the current state of an import job including `status`, `progress`, and any `errors` collected so far. Poll until `status` is one of `completed`, `failed`, or `not_implemented`.
List the authenticated user's tutoring sessions, newest first. Cursor-paginated — pass `cursor` from a previous response until `hasMore` is false.

post.description: Create up to 50 sessions in one request. Each entry is validated independently — the response carries the per-item outcome so partial successes are reported precisely.
Stream a Socratic tutor reply as `text/event-stream`. The tutor asks before it answers. Reuse the same `Idempotency-Key` to make network retries safe — replays return the same stream.

200.description: Server-Sent Events stream of the tutor's reply.

sessionCookie.name: sid
sessionCookie.description: Browser session cookie issued by /api/auth/login. 64-hex opaque token, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax.

mobileBearer.description: Mobile access token issued by /api/mobile/login. 15-minute TTL.

csrfDoubleSubmit.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfDoubleSubmit.description: CSRF double-submit token. Pair with a `csrf-token` cookie issued by /api/auth/csrf-token.

oauthBearer.description: OAuth 2.0 access token issued by /api/oauth/token, or a scoped agent API key (ak_*). Carries one or more of the scopes below.

scopes.chat:read: Read your chat sessions and messages.
scopes.memory:write: Add or update your cross-session memory notes.
scopes.sessions:read: List your tutoring sessions and their metadata.
scopes.files:read: Download files you uploaded or that Socrates produced for you.

scopes.chat:read: Read your chat sessions and messages.
scopes.memory:write: Add or update your cross-session memory notes.
scopes.sessions:read: List your tutoring sessions and their metadata.
scopes.files:read: Download files you uploaded or that Socrates produced for you.

oauthClientBasic.description: Registered OAuth client credentials (client_id:client_secret) for the token and revoke endpoints.

oauthClientPost.description: Alternative client-credentials-in-body auth for the token and revoke endpoints.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Client-generated unique key (UUID recommended). Replays within the 24-hour window return the original response.

IdempotencyKey.description: Make this write idempotent: same key + same request = same response, without duplicating side effects. Use on every mutating call when the network is unreliable.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous response's `nextCursor`. Pass it back until `hasMore` is false.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size. Defaults to 20; capped at 100.

RateLimitLimit.description: The maximum number of requests permitted in the current window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: The number of requests remaining in the current window.

RateLimitReset.description: Seconds until the current rate-limit window resets.

RetryAfter.description: RFC 6585 — seconds until the client should retry. Present on 429 responses.

BadRequest.description: Request was malformed. See `code` for the machine-readable reason.

WWW-Authenticate.description: RFC 6750 challenge. Includes `resource_metadata` so the agent can resolve the full auth chain from a single 401.

Forbidden.description: Credentials are valid but insufficient. Includes `error="insufficient_scope"` if a scope check failed.

Conflict.description: Resource conflict (e.g. duplicate key, already exists).

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit hit. Respect `Retry-After` and back off.

ErrorResponse.description: Typed error envelope. `code` is a stable machine-readable identifier from a closed vocabulary; `message` is a one-sentence explanation safe to show to a user; `detail` carries optional structured context; `requestId` correlates to the `X-Request-Id` response header.

detail.description: Optional structured context for the error — field-level validation errors, retry timing, etc.

requestId.description: Server-generated UUID. Matches the `X-Request-Id` response header for cross-log correlation.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Present on 429 responses. Seconds until the next request will be accepted.

expiresAt.description: Access token expiry (ISO 8601, typically 15 min after issue).

refreshExpiresAt.description: Refresh token expiry (ISO 8601, 30 days after issue).

scope.description: Optional; must be a subset of the originally granted scopes.

refresh_token.description: Omitted only if the originally issued grant had no refresh scope.

token.description: The access or refresh token to revoke.

expiresAt.description: Optional, capped at 1 year from creation.

credential.description: Full credential `ak_<keyId>.<secret>` shown ONCE. Store immediately — only the SHA-256 hash is persisted.

status.description: `not_implemented` means the importer for this source is not yet wired up; no data was modified.

payload.description: Source-specific blob. For `chatgpt`, pass the standard `conversations.json` array (or `{ sessions: [...] }`).

Page.description: Cursor-paginated response envelope. `nextCursor` is present whenever `hasMore` is true; pass it to the next request as `?cursor=`. When `hasMore` is false, `nextCursor` is null.

id.description: New session id, present when status=created.

code.description: Machine-readable error code, present when status=failed.
